messages:
sara.support: Heads-up — customer hit a weird case where rerank returns near-uniform scores after they swapped their embedding model. They say everything was fine before. Attaching their minimal repro and logs.

jamie.eng: Can you paste the curl / payload they used? also any error traces?

sara.support: sure — here's the embed call they used (embedding model = embed-lite-v1):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "embed-lite-v1",
  "input": ["What is Redwood Inference?", "How do we reduce latency?"]
}
```
Response: two vectors, each length 1024 (customer confirmed).

sara.support: then they sent those to the rerank endpoint: 
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "model": "rerank-pro-xx",
  "query_embedding": [ ... 1024 numbers ... ],
  "candidate_embeddings": [[ ... 1024 numbers ... ], ...]
}
```
No HTTP error, but scores look wrong — mostly 0.0001-0.0003 and ties across candidates.

jamie.eng: interesting. rerank-pro-xx expects 1536-d embeddings (catalog metadata shows embedding_dim=1536). If you feed 1024-d vectors it should return a 4xx. Do we have server logs?

sara.support: attached snippet from their proxy logs (sanitized):
```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z INFO incoming rerank request id=rc_abc123 model=rerank-pro-xx query_dim=1024 candidate_count=5
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z WARN embedding_dim_mismatch: expected=1536 got=1024 for request rc_abc123
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z WARN fallback: performed cosine on truncated vector (1024->1536 pad) request=rc_abc123
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z INFO rerank completed id=rc_abc123 duration_ms=112 score_variance=3.2e-7
```

jamie.eng: that log line is the problem — there was an automatic compatibility fallback that pads/truncates vectors to match expected dim. padding with zeros will collapse cosine distances -> near-uniform scores. We should NOT silently pad.

anand.ml: +1. Padding introduces bias. For production we enforce embedding_dim in the input validator and return 400 with guidance (model to use). For backwards compatibility we can add a strict mode toggle.

jamie.eng: Repro steps for eng to validate locally: 1) create 1024-d random vector, 5 candidate 1024-d vectors. 2) call rerank-pro-xx with those vectors. 3) compare scores vs same vectors up-projected to 1536 (zero pad). The padded case will show collapsed distribution. I'll paste quick python snippet.
```
# pseudo-repro
import numpy as np
q = np.random.randn(1024)
cands = [np.random.randn(1024) for _ in range(5)]
# naive pad to 1536
q_pad = np.concatenate([q, np.zeros(512)])
cands_pad = [np.concatenate([c, np.zeros(512)]) for c in cands]
# compute cosine similarities -> almost identical small variance
```

sara.support: Customer wants a hotfix — they swapped to embed-lite-v1 to cut cost. They prefer a short-term mitigation we can recommend.

anand.ml: Short-term: (1) validate dims client-side and return 400 + clear error message suggesting compatible rerank model or embedding model, (2) docs update with compatibility matrix, (3) in Console show warning when model combos are mismatched.

jamie.eng: Long-term: model catalog should expose embedding_dim metadata and rerank endpoint should reject at the API gateway rather than fallback. Also add a hygiene check in Optimize that suggests model pairings by workload (cost v accuracy).

sara.support: I'll reply to customer with: - explanation that silent padding causes poor scores - immediate workaround: re-run embeddings with a 1536-d model (embed-standard-v2) or use a reranker that accepts 1024 dims (rerank-lite) - we'll label this high priority and push a 400-fail fix to validate inputs. Anything to add? :thinking_face:

jamie.eng: include the exact error text they should see after the fix: 
`400 Bad Request: embedding vector length 1024 incompatible with reranker model 'rerank-pro-xx' (expected 1536). Use model 'embed-standard-v2' or 'rerank-lite'.`

ops-oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1123: "silent-embed-padding-causes-uninformative-rerank-scores" assigned to jamie.eng and anand.ml.

sara.support: thanks — I'll send customer the workaround and ETA for a fix (we'll aim to cut the validator change in next deploy cycle). :thumbsup:

jamie.eng: I'll open PR to remove silent pad fallback and add explicit dim check + helpful error. linking to this thread in the PR.

anand.ml: Also adding a unit test in model-onboarding that asserts embedding_dim present in catalog metadata and that pipeline rejects combos without matching dims.

sara.support: closing loop here — will follow up after PR lands and confirm with customer.
